messages.text: Hello, I am following up one final time regarding my unresolved order placed on July 6, 2026 for three BSB Bitaxe Gamma 602 units. I paid 170 USDT using the payment option provided through your checkout. I have since provided the transaction details and transaction hash several times, as well as additional information obtained from the payment provider to help your team locate and verify the transaction. Your last response was on August 23, 2026, when you told me that you were still waiting for your team to review the transaction. I have received no further update since then. More than three months have now passed since the payment was made. I cannot be expected to remain without either the products I purchased or the funds I paid because of an issue with a payment method offered through your checkout. I am therefore requesting that this matter be resolved within 10 calendar days (by October 17 ,2026) of this email, by one of the following: Fulfill my original order for three BSB Bitaxe Gamma 602 units If those units are no longer available, offer an equivalent product to me at no additional cost Provide a full refund of the amount paid, equivalent to 170 USDT, by the method of your choice If this matter is not resolved within 10 calendar days, I will proceed with a formal demand letter and pursue the remedies available to me. I have been patient and have provided all information reasonably required to resolve this matter. I now expect a concrete resolution. You have until October 17, 2026. Félix D.

Hi Félix,

Thank you for laying it all out again, and I'm sorry you've had to. Three months with neither the units nor your money back is not acceptable, and I won't try to defend it.

Here is where things actually stand on our side, plainly. The payment you made never created an order in our system, which is why nobody has been able to find it against your name or either of your addresses. That is our problem to solve, not yours, and you were right about the chain: the transaction is on Ethereum, so it is Etherscan and the Commerce dashboard that have to be checked, not Solscan. I'm sorry for the time lost on that.

I can't move money myself, so I've escalated this to Abel and Georges, our founders, with your transaction hash, the amount, the date and what you've asked for. They are on today and are picking it up now, and one of them will reply to you directly in this thread, not pass it back to a queue.

On the three options you listed: the BSB Bitaxe Gamma 602 is no longer in our catalogue, so realistically it will be an equivalent unit at no extra cost to you, or the 170 USDT returned. That choice is yours, and they will confirm the exact resolution with you.

Again, my apologies for how long this has taken.

Sarah
HeliumDeploy Support

Bonjour Félix,

Parfait, merci. J'ai transmis votre adresse de livraison à Abel et Georges, elle est au dossier avec la transaction et le montant payé.

Vous n'avez rien d'autre à faire pour l'instant. Ils créent la commande du Thor P2 manuellement avec votre crédit de 170 USD et vos deux codes appliqués, et vous recevrez la confirmation avec le numéro de commande dans ce fil. Aucun montant supplémentaire ne vous sera demandé.

Pour les cap····'écran, gardez-les sous la main. Votre description de la séquence MetaMask est déjà utile, et si l'équipe technique a besoin d'une image précise pour reproduire le problème, je vous le demanderai ici. Vous avez raison sur le fond, ce mode de paiement ne devrait pas créer ce genre de situation, et c'est aussi pour ça que votre cas remonte jusqu'aux fondateurs.

Merci encore pour votre patience et votre collaboration dans ce dossier, c'est sincèrement apprécié.

Sarah, équipe HeliumDeploy
